---
title: Settings reference
---

Every setting is available in the Garmin Connect app, Garmin Express, and on the watch
(hold the menu button on the watch face → **Watch Face** → **Customize**).
Colors set to **Auto (theme)** follow the selected color theme.

This page is generated from `tools/gen_settings.py`.

## Watch faces

*Watch face* picks a category (Analog, Digital) and a face within it. Each face uses its own
subset of the settings below; the *Faces* column lists where a setting applies.

| Value | Id | Category | Face | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `analog/plain` | Analog | Plain | Fully configurable analog: layouts, hands, dial, fields and gauges |
| 1 | `digital/plain` | Digital | Plain | Fully configurable digital: layouts, fonts, fields and gauges |
| 2 | `digital/tactix` | Digital | Tactix | The original tactix: upright LCD digits, seconds ring, battery and moon |

## General

Watch face, theme and base colors.

| Key | Setting | Default | Options | Faces |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Mode` | Watch face | Analog · Plain | Analog · Plain, Digital · Plain, Digital · Tactix | all |
| `Theme` | Color theme | Classic | Custom, Classic, Racing, Ocean, Forest, Gold, Ice, Neon, Paper, Stealth, Tactical | `analog/plain`, `digital/plain` |
| `BgColor` | Custom background | Black | 28 colors | `analog/plain`, `digital/plain` |
| `PrimaryColor` | Custom primary | White | 28 colors | `analog/plain`, `digital/plain` |
| `SecondaryColor` | Custom secondary | Light gray | 28 colors | `analog/plain`, `digital/plain` |
| `AccentColor` | Custom accent | Orange | 28 colors | `analog/plain`, `digital/plain` |
| `SecondsMode` | Seconds | Awake only | Off, Awake only, Always (MIP) | all |
| `StatusIcons` | Status icons | on | on / off | all |
| `HourFormat` | Hour format | System | System, 12 hour, 24 hour | all |

| `AnalogLayout` | Analog layout | Classic | Classic, Chronograph, Top + bottom, Minimal, Gauges, Pilot | `analog/plain` |

| `MinuteHand` | Minute hand | Baton | Baton, Dauphine, Sword, Leaf, Skeleton, Arrow, Needle, Rounded, Breguet | `analog/plain` |
| `SecondHand` | Second hand | Lollipop | Needle, Lollipop, Counterweight, Arrow tip, Square tip | `analog/plain` |
| `HandSize` | Hand width | Regular | Slim, Regular, Bold | `analog/plain` |
| `HandLength` | Hand length | Regular | Short, Regular, Long | `analog/plain` |
| `HandOutline` | Hand outline | on | on / off | `analog/plain` |
| `CenterCap` | Center cap | Dot | None, Dot, Ring, Large | `analog/plain` |
| `HourHandColor` | Hour hand color | Auto (theme) | 28 colors + Auto | `analog/plain` |
| `MinuteHandColor` | Minute hand color | Auto (theme) | 28 colors + Auto | `analog/plain` |
| `SecondHandColor` | Second hand color | Auto (theme) | 28 colors + Auto | `analog/plain` |

## Always on

AMOLED only: burn-in safe face while the watch sleeps. MIP shows the full face at all times.

| Key | Setting | Default | Options | Faces |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AodStyle` | AOD style | Auto | Auto, Full face, Minimal, Minimal + date, Time only | all |
| `AodColor` | AOD color (AMOLED) | Light gray | 28 colors | all |
| `AodFont` | AOD font | Same as time | Same as time, System, Condensed bold, Roboto, Roboto black, Bionic, Serif, Condensed italic, Quartz LCD, Quartz outline, Quartz thin, Dot matrix, Pixel blocks, Dotted fine, Segment upright | `digital/plain`, `digital/tactix` |
| `AodOutline` | Outline hands / digits (AMOLED) | on | on / off | all |
| `AodMarkers` | AOD markers | Quarters | None, Quarters, Hours | `analog/plain` |
| `AodShift` | Pixel shift (AMOLED) | on | on / off | all |

## Night

AMOLED only: fade all colors toward the background at night.

| Key | Setting | Default | Options | Faces |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `NightTrigger` | Night dimming | Off | Off, Do Not Disturb / sleep mode, Sleep schedule, Either | all |
| `NightFade` | Fade amount | 50% | 10%, 20%, 30%, 40%, 50%, 60%, 70%, 80%, 90% | all |
